nora: Proposing Lyric Systems private rollout on Mon 2026-04-14 22:00 UTC. Dedicated->Private slice move. Need quick thumbs: KMS rotation conflict, runtime/model pin, canary + rollback gates, runbook perms.

deploybot: created job id=rb-9964 scheduled=2026-04-14T22:00:00Z target=lyric-prod-private

ops-ryan: Their infra scheduled a KMS rotation at 2026-04-14T22:10Z on kms-lyric-02-prod. We need an exception or shift start to 23:00Z.

maya: Can Lyric delay rotation? If not, pushing to 23:00 reduces warm-up but acceptable.

sophie: I can send a customer note requesting 90m delay. Prefer to keep current slot.

chao: Runtime pin request: v1.12.0 (we saw p95 spikes on v1.13). Model pin: redwood-4-quant-stable. Canary: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> 100%. Rollback triggers: 5xx >2% for 5m OR p95 >2x baseline for 5m.

ops-ryan: Runbook `sops/rollouts/lyric/rb-9964.md` updated with smoke tests + rollback script at `s3://redwood-releases/rollback/lyric/rb-9964.sh`. I verified IAM perms. Need SRE + SE ack before 100% shift.

sophie: Customer replied: rotation delayed by 2 hours. Exception granted.

maya: Release notes draft pushed: https://internal.docs/rls/lyric-04-14 (WIP). Added note about model quant changes and customer-configured CIDRs.

nora: Pre-approvals?

chao: :thumbsup: SE ack. Pins and flags OK.

ops-ryan: :white_check_mark: SRE prechecks done, perms good.

nora: Approved. Locking schedule. I'll open war-room 30m prior. deploybot: please ensure notify-on-fail=oncall@redwood.internal and enable eval hooks for golden prompts.

deploybot: update: rb-9964 pinned runtime=v1.12.0 model=redwood-4-quant-stable flags=`--kv-cache=3G` notify-on-fail=oncall@redwood.internal eval-hooks=enabled

nora: Thanks all. War-room channel: #war-lyric-rb-9964. If rollback needed run `s3://redwood-releases/rollback/lyric/rb-9964.sh` and ping oncall.
